definition: fail to appreciate sth because it is always there
evidence: we take clean water for granted
example: Most people take clean tap water for granted until a pipe bursts downtown.
answer: take clean tap water for granted

more_examples.example: After the long hike, Maria realized she had taken her comfortable bed for granted.
more_examples.answer: had taken her comfortable bed for granted

more_examples.example: Please stop taking your grandmother's cooking for granted and thank her tonight.
more_examples.answer: taking your grandmother's cooking for granted

more_examples.example: Our team took the old server for granted, and then it crashed on Monday.
more_examples.answer: took the old server for granted

more_examples.example: Will you ever take a sunny weekend for granted again after this rainy year?
more_examples.answer: take a sunny weekend for granted

definition: do sth badly or cheaply to save time or money
example: The builders cut corners on the roof, so it started leaking within a month.

more_examples.example: If you are cutting corners on sleep before exams, your memory suffers.
That bakery has cut corners lately, and regulars noticed the cheaper butter.
Coaches warn young runners not to cut corners during their warm up.
Our accountant never cuts corners and checks every invoice twice.
